timeEntries.list.title: List Time Entries
timeEntries.list.description: List the authenticated user's Toggl Track time entries.

workspaces.get.title: Get Workspace
workspaces.get.description: Retrieve a Toggl Track workspace by ID via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}.

projects.get.title: Get Project
projects.get.description: Retrieve a Toggl Track project via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}.

projects.create.title: Create Project
projects.create.description: Create a Toggl Track project via POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects.

projects.update.title: Update Project
projects.update.description: Update a Toggl Track project via PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}.

tasks.get.title: Get Task
tasks.get.description: Retrieve a Toggl Track task via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}/tasks/{taskId}.

tasks.create.title: Create Task
tasks.create.description: Create a Toggl Track task via POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/projects/{projectId}/tasks.

timeEntries.get.title: Get Time Entry
timeEntries.get.description: Retrieve a Toggl Track time entry via GET /me/time_entries/{timeEntryId}.

timeEntries.current.title: Get Current Time Entry
timeEntries.current.description: Get the running Toggl Track time entry via GET /me/time_entries/current.

timeEntries.create.title: Create Time Entry
timeEntries.create.description: Create a Toggl Track time entry via POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time_entries.

duration.description: Duration in seconds; use -1 for a running timer.

stop.description: Optional stop time in UTC, ISO-8601.

timeEntries.update.title: Update Time Entry
timeEntries.update.description: Update a Toggl Track time entry via PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time_entries/{timeEntryId}.

timeEntries.stop.title: Stop Time Entry
timeEntries.stop.description: Stop a running Toggl Track time entry via PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time_entries/{timeEntryId}/stop.

timeEntries.delete.title: Delete Time Entry
timeEntries.delete.description: Delete a Toggl Track time entry via DELETE /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time_entries/{timeEntryId}.

clients.list.title: List Clients
clients.list.description: List Toggl Track clients in a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients.

tags.list.title: List Tags
tags.list.description: List Toggl Track tags in a workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags.

clients.create.title: Create Client
clients.create.description: Create a Toggl Track client via POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients.

clients.get.title: Get Client
clients.get.description: Retrieve a Toggl Track client via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients/{clientId}.

clients.update.title: Update Client
clients.update.description: Update a Toggl Track client via PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/clients/{clientId}.

countries.list.title: List Countries
countries.list.description: List the countries supported by Toggl Track via GET /countries.

countries.subdivisions.title: List Country Subdivisions
countries.subdivisions.description: List the subdivisions (states, provinces, regions) of a country via GET /countries/{countryId}/subdivisions.

currencies.list.title: List Currencies
currencies.list.description: List the currencies supported by Toggl Track via GET /currencies.

eventFilters.list.title: List Webhook Event Filters
eventFilters.list.description: List the event filters supported by Toggl webhook subscriptions via GET /event_filters.

groups.create.title: Create Group
groups.create.description: Create an organization group via POST /organizations/{organizationId}/groups.

users.description: Optional organization user IDs to add to the group.

workspaces.description: Workspace IDs to assign to the group.

invitations.create.title: Create Invitations
invitations.create.description: Invite users to a Toggl organization via POST /organizations/{organizationId}/invitations. At least one email is required; provide workspaces or a projectInvite so invitees land somewhere. Nested objects use the provider's wire field names.

emails.description: Email addresses to invite; at least one is required.

groups.description: Optional organization group IDs for the invitees.

skipEmail.description: When true, generate invitation URLs without sending emails.

workspaces.description: Workspaces to invite users to, using the provider's wire field names.

keys.get.title: Get JWKS Keys
keys.get.description: Retrieve the current JWKS keyset used to sign Toggl JWT tokens via GET /keys.

organizations.create.title: Create Organization
organizations.create.description: Create a Toggl organization with its default workspace via POST /organizations.

organizations.get.title: Get Organization
organizations.get.description: Retrieve a Toggl organization via GET /organizations/{organizationId}.

organizations.groups.title: List Organization Groups
organizations.groups.description: List the groups of a Toggl organization via GET /organizations/{organizationId}/groups.

organizations.users.title: List Organization Users
organizations.users.description: List the users of a Toggl organization via GET /organizations/{organizationId}/users.

filter.description: Match users by name or email substring.

activeStatus.description: Comma-separated statuses: active, inactive, or invited.

onlyAdmins.description: Return only users with administrative privileges.

groups.description: Comma-separated group IDs to filter by.

workspaces.description: Comma-separated workspace IDs to filter by.

plans.list.title: List All Plans
plans.list.description: Retrieve all Toggl subscription plans and their features via GET /subscriptions/plans.

projectUsers.create.title: Add Project User
projectUsers.create.description: Add a user to a Toggl workspace project via POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/project_users.

manager.description: Whether the user becomes a project manager.

rate.description: Hourly rate for this project user.

laborCost.description: Labor cost for this project user.

rateChangeMode.description: How rate changes apply to the project user.

laborCostChangeMode.description: How labor cost changes apply to the project user.

reports.searchTimeEntries.title: Search Detailed Report Time Entries
reports.searchTimeEntries.description: Search detailed-report time entries via POST /workspace/{workspaceId}/search/time_entries. Provide at least one report filter; pagination uses the X-Next-ID and X-Next-Row-Number response headers.

startDate.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD); must be before endDate.

endDate.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD); must be after startDate.

clientIds.description: Filter by client IDs; use null for entries without a client.

projectIds.description: Filter by project IDs; use null for entries without a project.

tagIds.description: Filter by tag IDs; use null for entries without tags.

taskIds.description: Filter by task IDs; use null for entries without a task.

grouped.description: Whether matching time entries should be grouped.

enrichResponse.description: Return as much related information as possible for each entry.

hideAmounts.description: Omit monetary amounts from the results.

orderBy.description: Field used to order report entries (default date).

firstId.description: First time-entry ID for cursor pagination.

firstRowNumber.description: First row number for cursor pagination.

rounding.description: Whether time should be rounded (0 or 1).

minDurationSeconds.description: Minimum entry duration in seconds (Time Audit).

maxDurationSeconds.description: Maximum entry duration in seconds (Time Audit).

tags.create.title: Create Tag
tags.create.description: Create a Toggl Track tag via POST /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags.

tags.update.title: Update Tag
tags.update.description: Rename a Toggl Track tag via PUT /workspaces/{workspaceId}/tags/{tagId}.

timeEntries.patch.title: Bulk Edit Time Entries
timeEntries.patch.description: Bulk edit up to 100 Toggl time entries via PATCH /workspaces/{workspaceId}/time_entries/{timeEntryIds} using RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations.

timeEntryIds.description: Comma-separated time-entry IDs to edit, at most 100 (for example 204301830,202700150).

meta.description: Include metadata for related entities in the response.

path.description: Path to the field, for example /description.

value.description: New value for the field at path.

patchInput.description: JSON Patch operations applied to every listed time entry.

timezones.list.title: List Timezones
timezones.list.description: List the timezones supported by Toggl Track via GET /timezones.

timezones.offsets.title: List Timezone Offsets
timezones.offsets.description: List the timezone offsets supported by Toggl Track via GET /timezones/offsets.

users.clients.title: List User Clients
users.clients.description: List all clients accessible to the authenticated user via GET /me/clients.

users.location.title: Get User Location
users.location.description: Get the authenticated user's last known location via GET /me/location.

users.preferences.title: Get User Preferences
users.preferences.description: Get the authenticated user's preferences via GET /me/preferences.

users.projects.title: List User Projects
users.projects.description: List the authenticated user's projects via GET /me/projects.

includeArchived.description: Include archived projects in the response.

since.description: Only projects modified since this Unix timestamp.

users.quota.title: Get User Quota
users.quota.description: Get the API rate-limit quota for the authenticated user via GET /me/quota.

users.tags.title: List User Tags
users.tags.description: List the tags visible to the authenticated user via GET /me/tags.

users.tasks.title: List User Tasks
users.tasks.description: List tasks across all workspaces accessible to the authenticated user via GET /me/tasks.

meta.description: Include metadata for related entities in the response.

webhookSubscriptions.delete.title: Delete Webhook Subscription
webhookSubscriptions.delete.description: Delete a Toggl webhook subscription via DELETE /subscriptions/{workspaceId}/{subscriptionId}.

webhooks.status.title: Get Webhooks Status
webhooks.status.description: Get the Toggl webhooks service status via GET /status.

workspaces.logo.title: Get Workspace Logo
workspaces.logo.description: Get the logo of a Toggl workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/logo.

workspaces.plans.title: List Public Subscription Plans
workspaces.plans.description: List the publicly available Toggl subscription plans via GET /workspaces/plans.

workspaces.preferences.title: Get Workspace Preferences
workspaces.preferences.description: Get the preferences of a Toggl workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/preferences.

workspaces.users.title: List Workspace Users
workspaces.users.description: List the users of a Toggl workspace via GET /workspaces/{workspaceId}/users.

excludeDeleted.description: Exclude deleted workspace users from the response.
